```yaml
name: FinOps Toolkit CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint PowerShell Scripts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "Invoke-PSAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse | Out-Default"

  unit-tests:
    name: Run Pester Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Execute Pester tests
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "Invoke-Pester -OutputFormat NUnitXml -OutputFile TestResults.xml"

      - name: Publish Pester test results
        uses: scacap/action-surefire-report@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          report_paths: TestResults.xml
          create_check: true
          check_name: Pester Tests
          fail_on_test_failures: true
          fail_if_no_tests: true
```
